system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Kubernetes ConfigMap manifest storing an nginx.conf configuration file mounted into an nginx Deployment at /etc/nginx/conf.d/.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Generate a Kubernetes ConfigMap manifest storing an nginx.conf configuration file mounted into an nginx Deployment at /etc/nginx/conf.d/.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx-config
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    server {
      listen 80;
      server_name example.com;

      location / {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index index.html;
      }

      error_page 500 502 503 504 /50x.html;
      location = /50x.html {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
      }
    }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:latest
        volumeMounts:
        - name: nginx-config
          mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
          readOnly: true
      volumes:
      - name: nginx-config
        configMap:
          name: nginx-config
          items:
          - key: nginx.conf
            path: nginx.conf
          defaultMode: 0644
